capabilities: Convert a canvas into a single longform markdown document
Embed cards, notes, images, audio, video, PDFs, canvases and websites in the output
Rearrange or delete document blocks at the canvas node level via navigation headings
Strip navigation headings and canvas metadata with a cleanup command to finish the document
extras: More detailed usage information is kept in a separate repository wiki rather than the README.
intentEvidence: Canvas2Document lets you convert any obsidian canvas structure with all content
problem: Obsidian canvases are two-dimensional graphs, so their content cannot be used directly as a linear document without manually copying each element out.
summary: Canvas converter that turns a complete Obsidian Canvas, including cards, notes and embedded media, into a single longform markdown document.
